name: B2B Portal Authentication (Email + 6-digit OTP)
journey_path: Existing Business Customer Registering & Logging-on to B2B Portal
sources: Registering on B2B Portal.pdf p1 (error banner)

automation_boundary.automated_scope: Login page -> OTP tab -> enter registered username/email -> CONTINUE (live label RECEIVE OTP) -> fill the six OTP boxes -> Proceed -> land on Select Organization or the Organization Dashboard.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: OTP delivery (e-mail and SMS) is external. The run must be handed the code; reading a mailbox or SMS inbox is out of scope.

steps.action: Navigate to the B2B Portal login page
steps.expected_result: The login page loads with the SIGN IN TO BUSINESS ONLINE panel and the email address field visible

steps.action: Confirm the OTP tab is the active tab of the credentials panel
steps.expected_result: 'Sign in using OTP' is selected and the heading reads 'Enter your email.'

steps.action: Enter the registered Organization Administrator email address
steps.expected_result: The email is accepted and the CONTINUE button becomes actionable

steps.action: Click CONTINUE to request the one-time password
steps.expected_result: The 'Enter your One Time Password.' panel opens stating the OTP was sent to the E-mail and Mobile number

steps.action: Check the masked destinations shown under the OTP panel heading
steps.expected_result: Email ID and Mobile Number are shown masked (e.g. p*********@e***.com, 0******32)

steps.action: Enter the six-digit OTP, one digit per box, using boxes 1 to 6 in order
steps.expected_result: All six boxes are filled and the green confirmation tick appears

steps.action: Click Proceed to submit the code
steps.expected_result: The code is verified and the portal leaves the OTP panel
steps.note: Existing KB observed verification without a separate button. Skip this step if the crawl confirms auto-submit.

steps.action: Dismiss the error dialog with OKAY when the OTP is rejected
steps.expected_result: The dialog closes and the user is returned to OTP entry without losing the session
Either 'Select a Organization to continue' (no default organization) or the Organization Dashboard (default organization) is displayed

conditional_branches.condition: identifier not associated with a customer
conditional_branches.outcome: stay on SCR_LOGIN with 'No Customer assosiated'

test_scenarios.title: Registered user with default org signs in by OTP and lands on the Organization Dashboard
Registered multi-org user without default signs in by OTP and is asked to select an organization
Unregistered email shows 'No Customer assosiated' and no OTP panel
Wrong OTP raises the error dialog; OKAY returns to OTP entry
Expired OTP is rejected
test_scenarios.precondition: wait beyond the OTP validity window (value to be confirmed)

test_scenarios.title: Five digits entered -- verification cannot be submitted
Non-numeric character typed into an OTP box is not accepted
Resend issues a new OTP; the new code signs the user in
OTP destinations are masked on the entry panel
CONTINUE stays disabled while the username field is empty
test_scenarios.basis: inferred from disabled CONTINUE in Sign-in using UAE Pass.pdf p1

open_questions: Live button label: RECEIVE OTP (QA XPath) or CONTINUE (design PDF)?
Is there a Proceed button after the 6 digits, or does verification auto-submit?
OTP validity period, resend cooldown and maximum wrong attempts for sign-in.
